output.reason: The changelog line [ev-16309ad83b65] gives only a title, but the linked PR fills the gaps P1 marked as open. [ev-92fe7f3a0534] says the subject is ApplicationSet Progressive Sync: apps in the step being synced get status Pending in the ApplicationSet's applicationStatus. It also says that before the fix, the sync could get stuck and never recover unless the operator deleted the applicationStatus or triggered a manual sync. [ev-5dcba269a9b1] gives the trigger: the ApplicationSet's target revision changes (for example, from commit A to commit B) while an app is still Pending. That defines who is exposed (ApplicationSets using progressive/rolling sync), and [ev-3b511d6c6a10] shows the fix is limited to the applicationset controller, so for an operator who does nothing the consequence is a controller-side fix that needs no action.
